categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Yongli Belting Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: polymer material lightweight conveyor belts and high-end precision molding products. The conveyor belts serve various industries including food, logistics, agriculture, textiles, and packaging, while the precision molding segment focuses on mold manufacturing and plastic injection parts for industries such as toys, smart home, consumer electronics, telecommunications, and healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer materials such as PVC, TPU, TPO, TPEE, and silicone coatings for conveyor belts, employing manufacturing processes including mixing, calendering, molding, and vulcanization. In precision molding, it leverages independent mold design and manufacturing capabilities, injection molding, secondary processing like silk screen printing, hot stamping, laser engraving, assembly, and 3D printing based on metal powders. The company emphasizes R&D in materials science, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large multinational corporations in industries such as food processing, logistics, agriculture, textiles, packaging, toys, smart home devices, consumer electronics, telecommunications, and healthcare. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of revenue derived from overseas sales to countries in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Shanghai, Guangdong, Anhui, Shenzhen, and other regions. It has established overseas subsidiaries and joint ventures in countries including Indonesia, Poland, Austria, Vietnam, Bangladesh, the Netherlands, Germany, South Korea, Japan, the United States, Mexico, Thailand, Australia, and Brazil, covering major global markets and the Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Yongli Belting Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and processing of conveyor belts and precision molded plastic components. It acts as a solution provider integrating design, manufacturing, and after-sales services, positioning itself close to end-users and OEM customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing environmentally friendly, energy-saving, and high-performance conveyor belts and precision molds. It aims to enhance product customization, digital transformation, and smart manufacturing capabilities. R&D efforts include new materials, automated production processes, and advanced mold design to improve product quality and expand into intelligent equipment sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products, including lightweight conveyor belts and precision molded plastic parts. The company employs a mix of direct sales and distributor channels domestically and internationally. It also provides value-added services such as product customization, installation, and after-sales support, contributing to its revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the lightweight conveyor belt industry, the company competes with international leaders like Habasit (Switzerland), Ammeraal (Netherlands), and Siegling (Germany), as well as strong regional players in Asia. Domestically, it is a leading enterprise with significant market share and technological capabilities. In precision molding, it holds a competitive position with global production bases and long-term partnerships with multinational clients, distinguishing itself through integrated one-stop solutions and advanced manufacturing technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.24 billion, representing a 10.69% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 223 million, a decrease of 40.73% mainly due to non-recurring gains in the prior year. The company maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 4.27 billion and continues to invest in expanding production capacity and overseas market penetration, demonstrating steady growth and operational cash flow improvement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Yongli emphasizes high-quality, customized, and environmentally friendly products with advanced material formulations and manufacturing processes. Its integrated design-manufacture-service business model enables tailored solutions that meet diverse industry requirements. The company’s global production and service network, combined with continuous innovation in smart and energy-efficient products, differentiates it from competitors and enhances customer satisfaction and loyalty.
